replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, yes. The moment I see a complex equation, my stomach tightens. It triggers old school fears. It's a weakness I've accepted, and I don't let it define my whole character.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I have not used AI for math learning recently. I find technology a bit overwhelming, and my experience with digital tools is limited. I prefer reading novels or doing yoga for relaxation. Math doesn't fit into my current routine, so I have no personal experience to report, and I prefer sticking to what I know works for me.
